assets.description: Authored capsule chain, closed segmented ring with central aperture, capsule J hook and Cartesian hand; no third-party asset files

infrastructure.reuse: Vendored casekit and adapted transport/container scaffolding only; own task physics

concept_source.verification: Source paths, commit and concept reviewed in independent high design review

adaptations: MuJoCo CPU engine and abstract single Cartesian manipulator
Only chain-top actuation; no hand-ring contact at any time
Eight collidable passive capsule links and a closed ring assembled from capsule segments with a real central hole, not a gap in the circumference
Physical capsule J hook without scripted capture or latch
Actual RGB feedback and robot proprioception only
Independent length, mass and hook-position configuration factors; per-episode random frozen layout
Qualified >=0.30 m/s entry before release, continuous topology and load-window support checked in independent replay
